concepts.definition: F16, Engagement baseline, is an operational profile entered at the choice between direct engagement and coordination. It imports F1 frames/context, F2 transitions/steps/configuration, F3 results/combination, F4 work state/resumption/reuse, F5 proportionality/cost, F6 claims/evidence/assessment/acceptance, F15 Product lineage objects and F13 work carriers. Imported consequences retain their owners. Its foundation-to-law table is a trace, not an additional rule or calculus binding; §23 records dispositions without deciding anything. The table is new in this corpus and has no rc.2 row.

grounding.quote:
This member is material family F16, Engagement baseline (operational
profile). The table below shows which of its rules follow from which
premises, in the format of
[FOUNDATIONS §3 Foundation to law](FOUNDATIONS.md#foundation-to-law),
which also states the standing of the consequences. An actor enters the
family here, at the choice between direct entry and coordination. The
family imports eight families under

Three parts add no
rule of their own: §5 Terms owned by ASSURANCE uses the tier-2 terms as
ASSURANCE §7 defines them; this table is a trace; and §23 records
dispositions and decides nothing. The rows name pillars 1 to 9. No row
names pillar 10, axiomatic calculus: this profile states no rule of the
a_c calculus and binds none.

concepts.label: Engagement baseline

concepts.definition: A frame whose evaluation family concerns selecting, constructing, assessing or disposing governed work. Executive, Worker and Reviewer are this profile's engagement frames.

grounding.quote:
An engagement frame is a frame (REFERENCE_FRAME §1) whose evaluation family
concerns selecting, constructing, assessing or disposing governed work.
Executive, Worker and Reviewer are this profile's engagement frames (P1;
rc.2 #engagement-frame).

concepts.label: Engagement frame

conditions: Needed by one engagement evaluation.
concepts.definition: An activated Product, requirement, design, identity, release, domain, implementation, test, operational, historical or capability frame.

grounding.quote:
A specialist frame is an activated Product, requirement, design, identity,
release, domain, implementation, test, operational, historical or
capability frame that one engagement evaluation needs.

concepts.label: Specialist frame

concepts.definition: A reusable evaluation-family archetype naming a recurring distinction. A family is not itself a complete frame declaration, concrete carrier, component, actor, architecture, owner or implementation.

grounding.quote:
A generic specialist-frame family is a reusable evaluation-family archetype
of this profile (§11). It names a recurring distinction that a project
either instantiates where material, has capable authority establish as
non-material for the governed outcome, or keeps as an explicit coverage
residual (P2, P6; rc.2 #generic-specialist-frame-family).

concepts.label: Generic specialist-frame family

concepts.definition: Testing frame, authoritative Product path and material combinatorial complexity are tier-2 terms owned and defined by ASSURANCE §7; this profile imports their definitions unchanged.

grounding.quote:
Testing frame, authoritative Product path and material combinatorial
complexity are tier-2 terms defined in ASSURANCE §7. This profile uses them
as defined there and adds nothing to them (P1; rc.2 #testing-frame,
#authoritative-product-path, #material-combinatorial-complexity).

concepts.label: ASSURANCE-owned terms

conditions: Acts under existing project decision authority.
concepts.definition: The engagement frame selecting or confirming the bounded activation configuration and consuming closed Worker and Reviewer results. It holds the complete Product view and current MVP or release mandate needed for priority, disposition and the next authorised action; it is not a universal semantic owner, controller, manager service or runtime observer.

grounding.quote:
Executive is this profile's label for the frame that selects or confirms
the bounded activation configuration and consumes closed Worker and
Reviewer results under existing project decision authority. It holds the
complete Product view and the current MVP or release mandate needed to
assign priority, apply disposition and select the next authorised action
(P6, P2; rc.2 #executive).

concepts.label: Executive

conditions: Activated as a frame within an exact intake.
concepts.definition: The constructor role of ACTIVATION §1. It constructs and self-reviews using operation authority inherited from the governing work relation, without acquiring admission, publication, acceptance or continuation authority.

grounding.quote:
Worker is this profile's label for the constructor role of ACTIVATION §1
activated as a frame. It owns construction and self-review inside its exact
intake, through the operation authority inherited from the governing work
relation. It acquires no admission, publication, acceptance or continuation
authority (P6; rc.2 #worker).

concepts.label: Worker

conditions: Separately activated under applicable assessment, independence, traceability, assurance and qualification requirements.
concepts.definition: Independent live-surface evaluation consumed by the ACTIVATION §1 assessment relation. It evaluates one exact subject and returns a closed result, with evidence-bound technical triage when findings exist. It does not implement repair, assign priority, apply disposition or activate the next frame.

grounding.quote:
Reviewer is this profile's label for the independent live-surface
evaluation that the assessment relation of ACTIVATION §1 consumes, governed
by EVALUATION §3 (independence and traceability) and EVALUATION §1 and §7
(assurance boundary and qualification freeze), activated as a frame. It
evaluates one exact subject and returns a closed result, with evidence-bound
technical triage when a finding exists. It does not implement the repair,
assign priority, apply disposition or activate the next frame (P6; rc.2
#reviewer).

concepts.label: Reviewer

concepts.definition: Technical triage assesses one finding against its exact evaluated claim and basis. Severity grades the consequence if it manifests; priority orders response relative to Product outcome, likelihood, exposure, current mandate, reversibility, dependencies, delay cost and capacity. Current-boundary effect is the Executive's recorded decision projection: blocks, requires narrowing, or may remain an explicit residual. Severity, priority, frame result and boundary effect are distinct values; the boundary effect is neither a result nor disposition and has no independent core-value mapping.

grounding.quote:
Severity grades the consequence if the finding manifests. Priority orders
the response relative to the complete Product outcome, likelihood and
exposure, the current MVP or release mandate, reversibility, dependencies,
cost of delay and available capacity. The Reviewer grades severity; the
Executive assigns priority (P6, P2).

Current-boundary effect is the Executive's recorded determination of what
one finding does to the current promotion boundary: it blocks it, requires
narrowing it, or may remain an explicit residual. It is a decision
projection, a state this profile declares, not a result and not a
disposition (§8): it maps to no core value of its own and decides nothing
by itself.

concepts.label: Technical triage and its distinct decision projections

conditions: Exists only after successful Worker activation.
concepts.definition: The Worker's closed output to its declared consumer, the Executive in the coordinated branch. Its five construction-availability values refine only 'a candidate is available': candidate_ready→satisfied; refused→falsified; incomplete→falsified; re_entry_requested(authority)→out_of_frame; re_entry_requested(basis)→invalid_basis. ACTIVATION §3 owns their grounds and total, exclusive mapping after lawful activation. These are carriers, not new semantic dispositions, assessments or acceptance.

grounding.quote:
The work-result values are the five values of construction availability,
the refinement that
[ACTIVATION §3](ACTIVATION.md#construction-availability) defines for the
predicate "a candidate is available". ACTIVATION §3 owns their grounds,
maps each to exactly one core value, and states that the mapping is total
and exclusive after lawful activation. In this profile they are carriers,
not new semantic dispositions, and none of them is an assessment or an
acceptance of the candidate (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results).

concepts.label: Work result

conditions: Activation detects an applicable mismatch or refusal cause.
concepts.definition: An activation_refusal returns its cause and the core value assigned by REFERENCE_FRAME §5 to the assigning authority or declared result carrier. It creates no Worker activation, Worker evaluation or Worker result.

grounding.quote:
An `activation_refusal`, with the cause and
core value that
[REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions) gives it,
returns to the assigning authority or declared result carrier and creates
neither a Worker activation nor a Worker result.

concepts.label: Activation refusal

concepts.definition: The subject identity required by ACTIVATION §7 transition evidence and EVALUATION §3 traceability. Generic method qualification requires freezing its construction result before material reference exposure; otherwise an immutable identity or equivalent exact-subject relation stabilises it sufficiently for the assessment. No lifecycle state named frozen is created.

grounding.quote:
An exact candidate is the subject identity that the transition evidence of
ACTIVATION §7 and the traceability of EVALUATION §3 require. Where generic
method qualification applies (EVALUATION §7), its construction result is
frozen before material reference exposure as that clause requires.
Elsewhere this profile stabilises the review subject through an immutable
identity or an equivalent exact-subject relation sufficient for the claimed
assessment. The profile creates no new lifecycle state named `frozen` (P3,
P6; rc.2 #exact-candidate).

concepts.label: Exact candidate

conditions: The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis adopts this profile.
concepts.definition: A projection consuming that basis and recording the selected profile mapping, exact outcome, actor envelopes, evidence coordinates and revision conditions additional to the Product binding. It is neither a second frame basis nor a source of the authority projected.

grounding.quote:
A baseline-adoption projection consumes the Product-owned Project
Reference-Frame Basis of PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7. Where that basis adopts
this profile, the projection records the selected profile mapping, exact
outcome, actor envelopes, evidence coordinates and revision conditions
needed in addition to the Product binding (§16). It is not a second
frame-basis definition and mints none of the authority it projects (P6;
rc.2 #baseline-adoption-projection).

concepts.label: Baseline-adoption projection

concepts.definition: The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis projects existing decisions and cites their material sources. Adoption of this profile and admission of a configuration are distinct relations. The basis is an object distinct from cited authorities and creates no local-axiom authority.

grounding.quote:
Two relations stay apart here. Adopting this profile for a Product is
the Product authority's act, recorded in its Project Reference-Frame Basis:
inclusion in a method cut makes the profile available, and only Product
authority adopts it
([PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7](PRODUCT_DEFINITION.md#7-collective-reference-frame-basis)).
Admitting a frame configuration, this profile's executive configuration or
another, for the decisions it makes follows the rule of
[ACTIVATION §1 Configuration](ACTIVATION.md#configuration), Admission of a
configuration: the smallest existing authority that owns each material
decision admits it, and admission creates no new authority over it.

concepts.label: Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis

concepts.definition: The Executive's finite frontier and closed-result-ledger cycle over every known material evaluation not closed on the current basis. Its conceptual U tracks unresolved evaluations and M a finite dependency-ready activation subset. The notation requires neither a scheduler nor a frame engine.

grounding.quote:
U0 = every known material evaluation not closed on the current basis

while U is non-empty:
  select a finite dependency-ready subset M that fits the assigned actors
  activate each member of M against the exact outcome and basis
  keep assurance-independent evaluations free of unclosed peer results

concepts.label: Attention cycle

concepts.definition: A basis for one Product or an explicit directed Product chain. It distinguishes every mutable Source Project, current Product Definition, exact candidate checkpoint, Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact, Development Product, dependent Product and composition edge. Every Development Product role binds one exact underlying Install; every edge names source and target roles, governing authority/contracts, lifecycle, evidence boundary, refusal and invalidation.

grounding.quote:
A governed outcome may concern one Product or an explicit directed chain of
Products. Its basis records the distinct role of every mutable Source
Project, current Product Definition, exact candidate checkpoint, Release
Cut, Product, Install, Artifact, Development Product, dependent Product and
composition edge. Each Development Product role binds one exact underlying
Install identity. Each edge names its source and target roles, its governing
authority and contracts, its lifecycle, its evidence boundary, its refusal
and its invalidation (P3, P6; rc.2 #product-chain-basis; the Product-role
map in the basis is PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7, the lineage objects FOUNDATIONS
§2).

concepts.label: Product-chain basis

conditions: Selected where bounded construction and delivery across successive tasks need separate attention.
concepts.definition: One lawful configuration allocating construction to Worker, specialised as Writer for documents and records, required assessment to Reviewer, and coordination to Executive within an existing admitted decision grant. It is neither the method's default nor a role inventory required for all work.
exceptions: Where one sufficient frame covers the task, direct entry applies.

grounding.quote:
The executive configuration is the configuration this profile describes,
in the sense of [ACTIVATION §1 Configuration](ACTIVATION.md#configuration).
It allocates construction to the Worker frame, specialised as Writer for
documents and records; assessment, where it is required, to the Reviewer
frame; and coordination across tasks to the Executive frame, which disposes
within the decision grant existing authority admits (§5, §8 to §10). It is
one configuration, selected where it fits the task, not an inventory of
roles that all work needs. Existing authority selects it or another
configuration under §16, and a configuration with other frames, names or
topology is evaluated against its own task as ACTIVATION §1 Configuration
states, not by its distance from this one (P0, P2, P6).

concepts.label: Executive configuration

concepts.definition: This profile's selected delivery strategy: the smallest real runnable path from a supported Product entry to a material outcome through the selected composition, established early and widened in bounded increments, or extended/revalidated when already present. It trades later widening for early end-to-end composition feedback without claiming superiority over lawful strategies of other configurations.

grounding.quote:
The Executive sequences delivery around a steel thread: the smallest real,
runnable path from a supported Product entry to a material outcome through
the selected composition. The path is established early and widened in
bounded increments; where it already exists, the affected thread is extended
or revalidated. Increments are chosen for consequential uncertainty,
dependency and interface reach, and failure impact (P2; rc.2
#steel-thread-delivery; the generic sequencing heuristic is SPEC_METHOD §8).

concepts.label: Steel-thread delivery

concepts.definition: Product family: evaluates one exact current Product claim, outcome, boundary and lifecycle using current Intent, Product, requirements, acceptance meaning and Product coordinates. Product and requirement authority retain meaning and acceptance; output is bounded evaluation and evidence. Immediate falsifier: design, code, tests, predecessor behaviour or local convention changes Product meaning or substitutes its subject.

grounding.quote: Design, code, tests, a predecessor's behaviour or a local convention changes Product meaning or substitutes another Product subject.

concepts.label: Product evaluation family

concepts.definition: Product Composition family: evaluates one exact directed edge preserving Product roles, Product Definition/Release Cut/Product/Install identities, Development Product bindings, contracts, authority, lifecycle, evidence boundary and invalidation. Chains use bounded edge activations and declared conjunction. Each Product keeps its meaning; cited authorities/contracts own the edge; output is evaluation evidence only. Falsifiers include inferred edges from nesting, shared implementation/actors, imports, tool reachability, matching output or builder convenience; confusing builder and authored Product; or one node silently redefining another.

grounding.quote: A chain is evaluated through bounded edge activations and a declared conjunction.

concepts.label: Product Composition evaluation family

concepts.definition: Design family: evaluates whether accepted structural HOW satisfies material constitutional WHAT, closes required design relations and preserves owners across topology. Accepted design under Product/requirements owns structure. Output may identify satisfaction, contradiction or design re-entry gaps, never invent Product truth. Falsifiers: implementation precedent resolving open material design, design creating Product meaning, or undeclared material relations/competing structures.

grounding.quote: The frame may identify satisfaction, contradiction or a design re-entry gap; it cannot invent Product truth.

concepts.label: Design evaluation family

concepts.definition: Design Component family: evaluates a bounded component and direct causal dependency cone against parent contract, internal relations, sibling seams and required outputs. Accepted design owns only its bounded composition decision; parent, sibling, Product, requirement and runtime owners retain theirs. Falsifiers: omitted material far-side seam, absorbed parent/sibling decision, or local closure despite unresolved direct composition.

grounding.quote: The component omits a material far-side seam, absorbs a sibling or parent decision, or reports local closure while its direct composition is unresolved.

concepts.label: Design Component evaluation family

concepts.definition: Public Boundary family: evaluates a supported entry/exit's assigned validation, selection, transport, refusal and projection while preserving interior owners. Product, interface, identity, security and accepted design define it. Output is a closed boundary evaluation, not recreated interior semantics. Falsifiers: interpreting owner meaning, sequencing hidden domain decisions, exposing interior carriers as Product truth, or admitting unsupported paths.

grounding.quote: The frame evaluates the boundary result or refusal and returns only its closed evaluation; it does not recreate interior semantics.

concepts.label: Public Boundary evaluation family

concepts.definition: Entity family: evaluates exact identity, kind, lifecycle, owner, representation and effect regime of one semantic, artifact or runtime entity. Product, domain, identity, requirement and accepted-design authority define it; output is identity- and lifecycle-bound evaluation. Falsifiers: substituting filename, wrapper, ticket, object shape, cache or process instance for stable identity, or collapsing lifecycle coordinates.

grounding.quote: The frame returns an identity- and lifecycle-bound evaluation.

concepts.label: Entity evaluation family

concepts.definition: Operator family: evaluates one material operation as an irreducible declared relation over admitted domain, inputs, outputs, refusals, algebra, effects and lawful compositions. Product, requirements, accepted ontology/design and the named operation owner define it. Evaluation creates no additional executable plan. Falsifiers: treating an endpoint/function/class/command/file label as the semantic atom, hiding the operator in orchestration, or rebuilding generic mechanics as domain law.

grounding.quote: The frame evaluates it without creating another executable plan.

concepts.label: Operator evaluation family

concepts.definition: Owner family: evaluates preservation of an authority-bearing or semantic relation's owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis, lifecycle, refusal invariants and permitted delegation. Existing named authority owns the relation; output is authority-congruence evaluation only. Falsifiers: rival reconstruction of judgment, treating source authorship as authority transfer, or widening a grant through proxy, foundation, frame or actor.

grounding.quote: The frame may evaluate authority congruence only.

concepts.label: Owner evaluation family

concepts.definition: Effect family: evaluates an action's pure, observational, artifact or runtime effect regime, including material commit, failure, retry, recovery, compensation, admission and projection law. Applicable Product, requirement, design, artifact, runtime and admission owners retain decisions. Output is effect-bound result/evidence. Falsifiers: collapsed regimes, owner-bypassing mutation, compensation treated as semantic rollback, or a read becoming rival writable truth.

grounding.quote: The frame returns an effect-bound result and evidence.

concepts.label: Effect evaluation family

concepts.definition: Reuse/Foundation family: evaluates normalisation and comparison of a material generic capability/dependency against credible lawful foundations, retaining irreducible local remainder and authority-bearing roles. Design capability/foundation selection law and the existing trade-off owner govern selection; no semantic authority moves to the foundation. Falsifiers: incumbent/local preference without bounded comparison, reproducing richer lawful foundations, scoring unknowns favourably or assigning owner authority to reuse.

grounding.quote: The frame cannot move semantic authority to a foundation.

concepts.label: Reuse/Foundation evaluation family

concepts.definition: Install family: evaluates resolution and exercise of exact Product, release, artifact, dependencies, configuration and callable entry through the admitted installed coordinate independently of mutable-source convenience. Product, identity, release, dependency, packaging and accepted design define the subject. Output is installed identity, reachability and refusal evidence. Falsifiers: substituting source imports, ambient resolution, registries, fixtures, rebuilt artifacts or moving workspaces for the claimed installed subject.

grounding.quote: The frame returns installed identity, reachability and refusal evidence.

concepts.label: Install evaluation family

concepts.definition: Proof family: evaluates congruence of an exact claim's subject, basis, path, population, oracle, evidence, falsifier, residual boundary and invalidation. Claim owner keeps meaning; applicable testing, assurance, review, Product and release owners govern evaluation/acceptance. Output is evidence and closed evaluation, never Product meaning or disposition. Falsifiers: harness-recreated owner meaning, wrong subject/path, counts or aggregate green substituted for claims, or proof tooling mutating the subject undetectably.

grounding.quote: The frame returns evidence and a closed evaluation result, not Product meaning or disposition.

concepts.label: Proof evaluation family

concepts.definition: A claim whose value comes from its declared conjunction. Coverage is the union of admissible observations contributed by activated frames. Each material cross-frame seam is a mandatory result or required coverage preserving or lawfully translating exact identity, coordinate, basis, carried value/evidence, lifecycle scope, authority and provenance.

grounding.quote:
Coverage records the union of admissible observations the activated frames
contribute. A composite claim takes the value of its declared conjunction
under
[FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results),
Reported value. This profile's declared rule makes each material
cross-frame seam a mandatory result or required coverage: the seam
preserves, or lawfully translates, exact identity, coordinate and basis,
carried value or evidence, lifecycle scope, authority and provenance

concepts.label: Composite claim and seam coverage

conditions: The specialist set is adopted.
concepts.definition: ASSURANCE §7 user-acceptance, end-to-end, integration and unit testing frames supply claim-congruent evidence to Proof evaluations while retaining distinct claims and coordinates. The ASSURANCE §13 end-to-end interface integration frame relates Public Boundary, Design, Operator, Owner and Proof to integration, end-to-end and user-acceptance frames; its computational whole-path evaluation composes selected interface claims with Operator, Owner, Reuse/Foundation and Proof. Neither adds a thirteenth family, fifth testing type, role or universal activation gate.

grounding.quote:
The end-to-end interface integration frame (ASSURANCE §13) relates the
Public Boundary, Design, Operator, Owner and Proof families to the
integration, end-to-end and user-acceptance frames. Its computational
whole-path evaluation composes the selected interface claims with Operator,
Owner, Reuse/Foundation and Proof. Neither adds a thirteenth family, a fifth
testing type, a role or a universal activation gate (P2; rc.2
#derived-end-to-end-interface-integration-frame,
#computational-whole-path-evaluation).

concepts.label: Testing and interface frame relations

concepts.definition: Eight bounded communication projections: Worker activation, activation refusal, work result, Reviewer activation, review result, specialist activation, specialist result, and disposition/checkpoint. They carry exact intake/results and source routes between declared producers and consumers, without creating authority or implicit continuation.

grounding.quote:
The coordinated branch uses the following bounded projections. They may be
fields in existing Goals, tickets, design assets, commentary, qualification
or release evidence, or other admitted carriers; the profile requires no new
artifact type (P2, P6; rc.2 #handoff-projection).

concepts.label: Handoff projections

concepts.definition: A configuration defined by existing Product, requirement, Goals or accepted-design authority, potentially using different frames, names, overlaps, sequences and actor bindings. It is evaluated against its task, dependencies, actor limits, authority and required assurance, retaining every applicable method relation and identifying claim coverage.

grounding.quote:
A project configuration need not keep the labels Executive, Worker and
Reviewer or map one local frame to each. It keeps every applicable method
relation and identifies how its evaluations cover the claims it makes. It
is evaluated against its task, its dependencies, its actors' limits, the
authority it applies and the required assurance, as ACTIVATION §1
Configuration states, never by its labels, its topology or its difference
from this profile. A local axioms document may carry the accepted
configuration; its authority is the cited Goals, Product, requirement or
accepted-design decision, not the document's category (P6, P1).

concepts.label: Project-defined configuration

conditions: Instance premises apply where the executive configuration is selected.

grounding.quote:
Standing of the commitments
cited ([FOUNDATIONS §3](FOUNDATIONS.md#3-commitments)): P0 recovered; P1,
P2, P3, P4a and P6 independent; P4b derived from P0 and P2, with P0's
premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable; P5 derived from P0
and P6, with P0's open-world premise. Its instance premises hold where
the executive configuration is selected; they are adopted with it and do
not follow from the foundations (P1, P6):

- I1: the work is a series of bounded tasks under one governed outcome,
  and carrying out a bounded change and managing delivery across the tasks
  need separate attention;
- I2: existing project authority (Goals, Product, requirements, accepted
  design, a work item, identity or release law) holds every decision grant
  the configuration applies;
- I3: the actors are fallible and have finite context and attention, and a
  constructing actor may be probabilistic.

constraints.statement: Preserve the source's premise standing: P0 recovered; P1/P2/P3/P4a/P6 independent; P4b derived from P0/P2 with non-reacquirable step facts; P5 derived from P0/P6 with the open-world premise. I1 bounded tasks with separate construction/delivery attention, I2 existing project ownership of every applied decision grant, and I3 fallible finite actors, possibly probabilistic constructors, are adopted instance premises, not foundational consequences. Profile choices retain profile ownership; Product choices retain Product ownership; imported law controls conflicts. Inclusion in a method cut supplies availability, not adoption or a grant. Names bind allocated responsibilities, not spelling-derived authority. Consumers apply only their owning rule's decisions; the trace does not confer authority.

conditions: A claim of profile qualification or work-item closure is made.

grounding.quote: By P5 `indeterminate` never maps to `satisfied`, so a closed `indeterminate` result or a review event satisfies no unresolved obligation; the closure condition of a work item (F13) is applied to the selected branch only

constraints.statement: Qualification reaches only evaluated revisions, envelopes, branches and populations. Mechanical document checks and source-linked Reviewer evaluation are bound together but neither establishes the other's claim. Closed indeterminate results and review events discharge no unresolved obligation; indeterminate never becomes satisfied. Apply imported closure only to the selected branch, including recording satisfied conditions for a sufficient direct outcome. The table attributes twenty-six representative trial obligations and twenty-four application/closure conditions to the profile as applications of traced law, not new rules.
constraints.uncertainty: The actual trial obligations, closure conditions and imported closure rule are not supplied.

constraints.statement: One bounded authority selects active work and finite evaluation frames. Worker constructs one exact candidate, self-reviews, reports and stops. Required independent assessment uses a separately activated Reviewer acquiring sufficient exact live authority, subject and evidence, reusing valid facts but supplying its own judgment; it returns supported severity/implications without implementing. Required coordination assigns priority and adjudicates the current mandate within an existing bounded grant. Delivery practice and failures may inform selection, qualification and revision, never become method authority or import consumer architecture, names, actors, topology, runtime, artifacts or stages. Failure to perceive known violations indicates a missing, misactivated, oversized or capability-incompatible frame. Resets, long repairs, moving review subjects, proof masking, duplicate authority and Product drift justify reevaluation of possible frame/activation/capability/basis/authority defects, not a universal architecture or authoritative precedent. Shared visibility or delivery-chain participation does not turn implementations, specialisations, scenarios, dependencies, installed builders or downstream Products into the authored Product.
constraints.uncertainty: Signals support diagnosis; they do not identify a unique defect or verdict.

conditions: A member, file, component or lens is claimed as a frame; or a family instance is activated.

grounding.quote:
A method member,
file, component or lens becomes a frame only when its evaluation, basis,
material manifold, authority, evidence, result algebra and capability
envelope are declared (REFERENCE_FRAME §13, minimal frame declaration; P1,
P6; rc.2 #specialist-frame).

Each
row is an evaluation archetype, not a complete frame declaration
(REFERENCE_FRAME §13). An adopting project binds, for every activated
instance, the exact subject, basis, material manifold, coordinates,
invariants, authority, evidence, exclusions, result algebra, capability
envelope, dependencies and invalidation conditions (P2, P6; rc.2
#derived-generic-specialist-frame-set).

constraints.statement: Frame status requires declared evaluation, basis, material manifold, authority, evidence, result algebra and capability envelope. Every activated family instance additionally binds exact subject, coordinates, invariants, exclusions, dependencies and invalidation conditions. Family labels resolve inside urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation, owned by REFERENCE_FRAME under the selected basis; same-spelled Product, Owner, Entity, Operator, Install and other labels do not become equal across Product, authority, domain or runtime contexts. Every material cross-context seam needs an explicit relation. Family topology is non-hierarchical and may overlap: it does not give Product topology precedence over Design, Owner authority over Entity/Operator, or Proof Reviewer/acceptance/disposition authority. Existing authority remains controlling.

conditions: For each governed outcome and every family.

grounding.quote:
For each governed outcome the known evaluation inventory (REFERENCE_FRAME
§8) disposes every family as one of (P2, P6, P5):

- instantiated by one or more exact frame declarations or authoritative
  acquisition paths, because the family is material;
- evidenced as non-material to the exact outcome by the authority capable
  of that determination; or
- kept as an explicit uncovered, conditional, conflicted or `out_of_frame`
  residual.

The absence of a named file, component, runtime object or actor is no
evidence that a family is non-material. Conversely, adopting this profile
does not require a project to create twelve components or to activate
twelve frames for every task (P2, P1).

constraints.statement: Dispose every family through one or more exact declarations or authoritative acquisition paths when material; evidence of non-materiality to the exact outcome from capable authority; or an explicit uncovered, conditional, conflicted or out_of_frame residual. Missing files, components, runtime objects or actors do not evidence non-materiality. Adoption requires neither twelve components nor twelve activated frames per task.

conditions: A finding is evaluated against its exact claim and basis.

grounding.quote:
This profile imposes no
universal numeric scale. Severity, priority, the frame result
(FOUNDATIONS §4 Results) and the current-boundary effect are four distinct
values. When a finding can block a promotion boundary is
[EVALUATION §5 When a finding blocks promotion](EVALUATION.md#when-a-finding-blocks-promotion),
and none of the four values alone decides it (P6, P1).

constraints.statement: Where admissible evidence and capability support them, triage records affected claim/failure, Product-scale severity, cause and confidence as a quantified assurance claim, blast radius and affected users/paths/relations, available workaround/containment, repair complexity, regression risk, dependencies, uncertainty and evidence that would reduce it. Missing causal/repair support stays explicit; evaluation-changing gaps return indeterminate or out_of_frame pressure, not invented precision or sideways Worker tasks. Reviewer grades severity; Executive assigns priority. Product-owned basis binds severity/priority scales, current-boundary cutoff and hard-stop conditions; no universal numeric scale is imposed. Imported hard-stop classes are typical, not closed, and stops remain non-waivable regardless of priority, cutoff or risk appetite. Blocking follows EVALUATION §5, not any one severity, priority, result or boundary-effect value. Boundary effect records a reading; only the applied disposition carries the decision through the core and decides acceptance. Lower priority cannot waive a hard stop or falsified mandatory claim. A severe label outside the exact claim cannot open another review round.
constraints.uncertainty: The imported blocking conditions and quantified-assurance requirements are not fully supplied.

conditions: Work-result mapping applies only after lawful activation.

grounding.quote:
- `candidate_ready` (`satisfied`): the consumer receives the exact
  candidate and its transition evidence and decides whether independent
  review is required (§12 step 4); the value is not `accept`;
- `refused` (`falsified`): the work result names the prohibition or
  refusal that is the value's counterexample; the Executive verifies the
  basis and applies the existing authority relation (§12 step 4);
- `incomplete` (`falsified`): the Worker's residuals and stop basis name
  each evaluation it did not perform, which has no result, each it
  performed that its evidence could not decide, which keeps its own
  `indeterminate`, and whether bounded execution ended first. The work
  result is never read as `indeterminate`, as ACTIVATION §3 states, and
  the Executive reactivates work only where current authority already
  permits it (§12 step 4);
- `re_entry_requested(authority)` (`out_of_frame`): the Executive returns
  the question to the decision owner the value names; and
- `re_entry_requested(basis)` (`invalid_basis`): the Executive revalidates
  the basis lock (§6 Drift locks) before any further activation.

constraints.statement: candidate_ready binds exact candidate and transition evidence and prompts the consumer's independent-review requirement decision; it is not accept. refused names its prohibition/refusal counterexample and requires basis verification and existing authority. incomplete distinguishes each unperformed evaluation with no result from each performed undecidable evaluation retaining its own indeterminate, and records whether execution bounds ended first; the availability result itself remains falsified, never indeterminate. Reactivation needs current permission. Authority re-entry goes to the named decision owner; basis re-entry requires lock revalidation before further activation. Capability, authority, stale/ambiguous-basis or topology mismatch known at activation yields activation_refusal, never a synthetic Worker result. Existing carriers reference current computed classification, evidence, residual judgments and original rulings without reconstructing unchanged C/J/O. Consumers check applicability and concrete invalidators; changed evidence revises only affected results, retaining originals and supported surviving claims.
constraints.uncertainty: ACTIVATION §3 owns selection grounds; the local mapping is not a replacement for them.

conditions: Within one governed outcome.

grounding.quote:
1. attention management: it keeps the exact outcome and basis, the
   Product-role map, the evaluation inventory, the dependency relation, the
   unresolved frontier, the actor envelopes, the current MVP or release
   mandate, the applicable triage policy and the residual boundary, and it
   selects the smallest dependency-ready activation set sufficient for the
   next decision within the finite actor envelopes;
2. evaluation orchestration: it activates capable Workers, Reviewers or
   specialists, keeps their exact subjects and bases, and consumes only
   closed results or declared translations; and
3. authorised action selection: it assigns priority, determines the effect
   on the current promotion boundary, applies an existing disposition, and
   issues only the next already-authorised activation or action.

constraints.statement: The Executive's inseparable duties are attention, evaluation orchestration and authorised action selection. Keep exact outcome/basis, Product-role map, inventory, dependencies, frontier, actor envelopes, current mandate, triage policy and residual boundary; select the smallest dependency-ready set sufficient for the next decision within finite envelopes. Activate capable Workers, Reviewers or specialists, maintain exact subjects/bases and consume only closed results or declared translations. Assign priority/boundary effect, apply an existing disposition and issue only the next already-authorised action. The Executive neither contains the whole workspace nor performs every evaluation. Its label grants no Product meaning, implementation, mutation, acceptance, publication or other operation authority; material effects remain with the actor carrying the exact operation grant.

conditions: The executive configuration is selected.
An actor occupies the Executive frame.

grounding.quote:
An actor occupying the Executive frame modifies no candidate, Product or
worktree bytes and performs no implementation effect. Filesystem or tool
access is no exception, and neither is an edit that is small, test-only,
reversible or apparently obvious. Mutation requires a separately activated
Worker or Writer relation carrying the exact operation grant, subject and
write territory. A same-actor role transition is explicit and is recorded in
the existing work carrier before the effect; for that effect the actor is no
longer acting as Executive. Recording or delegating after an Executive edit
cannot authorise the edit retroactively (P6, P3). This prohibition is this
profile's, and it applies wherever the executive configuration is selected
([ACTIVATION §1 Configuration](ACTIVATION.md#configuration), Example; §7);
an operation grant covering a construction, status and checkpoint sequence
does not lift it
([ACTIVATION §1 Roles and delegation](ACTIVATION.md#roles-and-delegation)).

constraints.statement: No candidate, Product or worktree-byte changes or implementation effects are permitted while Executive. Access, smallness, test-only scope, reversibility, obviousness and a construction/status/checkpoint operation grant provide no exception. Mutation requires a separately activated Worker/Writer relation with exact grant, subject and territory. The same actor may transition only explicitly, recorded in the existing carrier before the effect, and then acts outside the Executive role. Later recording or delegation cannot authorise a prior edit.

conditions: Known material evaluations remain unclosed on the current basis.

grounding.quote:
when no other authorised decision is ready:
    await decision-relevant input (event-driven attention, below)
  record every closed result, technical triage, residual and invalidation condition
  apply only declared conjunctions or translations
  assign priority and boundary effect only under the current Product mandate
  invalidate affected results when the subject or basis changes
  update U from coverage, dependencies, conflicts and discovered materiality

stop only when every mandatory evaluation is closed, or governing authority
has explicitly retained every remaining residual consistently with the claim

constraints.statement: Select finite dependency-ready activations fitting actors and exact outcome/basis; keep assurance-independent evaluations free from unclosed peer results. Wait when no authorised decision is ready. Record every closed result, triage, residual and invalidation condition; use only declared conjunctions/translations; assign priority and effect only under the current mandate; invalidate affected results after subject/basis change; update the frontier from coverage, dependencies, conflicts and discovered materiality. Stop only when every mandatory evaluation is closed or governing authority explicitly retains every remaining residual consistently with the claim. Parallel activations are permitted; recursion follows declared dependencies and bounded refinements, not undifferentiated nested/joined copies. Hold frontier/closed ledger rather than evaluator working contexts. Severity evidence, priority, boundary effect, disposition and next action remain distinct ledger entries even under mapping policy. Results return by explicit relation to Executive, declared conjunction or another frame, with source routes rather than hidden reasoning; no result itself activates or authorises continuation.

exceptions: Unavailable or unreliable notification, or an actual supervision obligation, requires bounded fallback observation.

grounding.quote:
Executive attention is event-driven by default. The Executive re-enters the
attention cycle for a decision-relevant closed result, a material exception
or changed basis, an owner request, or a declared deadline or checkpoint.
While Workers carry out their bounded grants and no other authorised
decision is ready, it waits. It does not repeatedly inspect unfinished work,
replay unchanged judgments or request status without a decision need (P0,
P2; rc.2 #event-driven-executive-attention).

Where notification is unavailable or unreliable, or an actual supervision
obligation requires observation, the Executive uses bounded fallback
observation with a declared purpose, cadence or checkpoint, evidence target,
and stop or escalation condition. Silence proves neither progress nor
failure. A genuine blocker or material risk is investigated, with
intervention where required, within existing grants; unknown status alone
does not establish a stalled Worker (P5, P6).

constraints.statement: Default re-entry triggers are decision-relevant closed results, material exceptions/basis changes, owner requests and declared deadlines/checkpoints. Wait during bounded Worker execution when no authorised decision is ready; no repeated unfinished-work inspection, unchanged-judgment replay or status requests without decision need. Retain frontier, return conditions and valid support; refresh affected support after material observations and revalidate locks before activation/disposition. Waiting waives no workspace verification, evidence, independent-assessment, closed-result, authority or closure duty. Fallback observation declares purpose, cadence/checkpoint, evidence target and stop/escalation. Silence proves neither progress nor failure; unknown status does not prove a stall. Investigate genuine blockers/risks and intervene where required within grants. Repeated no-progress observations or returns lacking new decision-relevant evidence require bounded reassessment of frame/grant/dependency/evidence and an authorised decision, not continued polling or identical repair on an unchanged basis. Reduced churn neither reduces assurance/capability nor imposes a universal cost/budget/accounting gate.

conditions: Before activation and before disposition.

grounding.quote:
| outcome lock | the selected Goal, Product outcome, boundary and lawful re-entry class, the current MVP or release mandate, and the triage policy are unchanged |
| basis lock | the subject, authority, dependency, configuration, topology, evidence, time and candidate coordinates are exact and current |
| Product-role lock | the mutable Source Project, Product Definition, Release Cut, Product, Install, Artifact and dependent Product identities stay distinct, and every Development Product role stays bound to its exact underlying Install |
| authority lock | the semantic, evaluation, operation, decision, acceptance and publication owners and grants are unchanged |
| coverage-and-return lock | every material evaluation and interaction is closed or an explicit residual, and every consumed result followed its declared return relation |

| changed Product meaning (outcome lock) | `re_enter` to the owning relation ([ACTIVATION §3 Disposition](ACTIVATION.md#disposition)) |
| stale or substituted basis, before activation (basis lock) | the activation refuses: `activation_refusal(basis)`, `invalid_basis` ([REFERENCE_FRAME §5](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#5-method-functions)) |
| stale or substituted basis of an evaluation performed on it | that evaluation's own result is `invalid_basis`, or it is reactivated on the current basis ([RF-005](REFERENCE_FRAME.md#rf-005-exact-basis-and-coordinates)) |
| stale basis of a held result, before disposition | for the disposition's conjunction the component has no applicable closed result: a gap, never relabelled `invalid_basis` and never counted as returned ([FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results](FOUNDATIONS.md#conjunction-of-results), Stale results) |
| missing material scope | `out_of_frame`: at activation, as [ACTIVATION §3 Admission and activation](ACTIVATION.md#admission-and-activation) states; for an evaluation, on the ground [FOUNDATIONS §4 Results](FOUNDATIONS.md#results) gives, an undeclared material relation or capability |
| missing operation authority (authority lock) | the activation refuses, `activation_refusal(authority)` (REFERENCE_FRAME §5), or the effect is refused |
| an unresolved mandatory conflict (coverage-and-return lock) | the conjunction is not `satisfied`; the conflict survives every join (FOUNDATIONS §4 Conjunction of results, Survival) |

constraints.statement: Revalidate all five locks: unchanged outcome/Goal/boundary/lawful re-entry/current mandate/triage policy; exact current subject/authority/dependency/configuration/topology/evidence/time/candidate basis coordinates; distinct Product-chain identities and exact Development Product Install bindings; unchanged semantic/evaluation/operation/decision/acceptance/publication owners and grants; and closed-or-explicit-residual material evaluations/interactions with declared return paths. Failed locks take only owner-defined outcomes: changed Product meaning→re_enter; stale/substituted preactivation basis→activation_refusal(basis)/invalid_basis; evaluation performed on stale/substituted basis→its own invalid_basis or current-basis reactivation; stale held result at disposition→gap with no applicable returned result, never relabelled invalid_basis; missing scope→out_of_frame under activation/evaluation-specific grounds; missing operation authority→activation_refusal(authority) or refused effect; mandatory conflict→non-satisfied conjunction with conflict surviving every join. Executive enlargement repairs none of these.

grounding.quote:
Exact basis does not make a Source Project immutable. A Worker may
cumulatively mutate the exact Source Project and write territory named by
its operation grant. A Reviewer evaluates an exact candidate checkpoint
produced from that workspace. A repair advances the workspace, creates a new
candidate and invalidates the affected results. A released Product, Release
Cut or exact Install stays immutable under its own lifecycle law and imposes
no immutability on the Source Project constructing a successor (P3, P4b).

constraints.statement: An installed Product may lawfully build its successor or another Product while remaining distinct from mutable Source Project and authored Product. Nesting, shared code/actors, imports, reachability, matching labels and equal outputs establish no identity, composition edge or authority transfer. Exact basis does not freeze the Source Project: Worker may cumulatively mutate only its granted exact subject/territory. Reviewer assesses an exact produced checkpoint. Repair advances workspace, creates a new candidate and invalidates affected results. Released Product, Release Cut and exact Install immutability remains under their own lifecycle laws and does not transfer to successor construction.

grounding.quote:
1. authority precedence, RF-009's structure of that name, decides which
   existing surface may select work, admit a frame configuration, dispose
   a result or require re-entry;
2. temporal and evidence flow, RF-009's communication, carries activation
   packets and closed results; and
3. frame topology records disjointness, overlap, conjunction, translation
   or composition among the evaluations actually used (REFERENCE_FRAME §7),
   while evaluation independence and Reviewer assurance independence stay
   separate activation relations.

constraints.statement: Authority precedence determines existing decision surfaces; temporal/evidence flow carries packets/results; frame topology records disjointness, overlap, conjunction, translation and composition. These and RF-009's other structures may align where warranted but never merge into one hierarchy; evaluation independence and Reviewer assurance independence remain separate activation relations. Shared method basis, outcome, checkpoint, affected relations, candidate, evidence and residuals collapse neither evaluation nor authority. Executive evaluates activation/priority/effect/disposition, Worker bounded construction, Reviewer exact claims/triage when activated. One activated evaluation combines engagement frame, material specialists, exact subject/basis and capable actor; the notation requires no Cartesian-product schema or universal runtime.
constraints.uncertainty: RF-009's complete list is outside the supplied text.

conditions: The executive configuration is selected where it fits.

grounding.quote:
Where it is selected, every grant, duty, limit and prohibition this
profile places on its frames is in force without exception: the
Executive's prohibition on mutation (§6 No mutation while Executive), its
duties under §6 The three duties, Attention cycle, Event-driven attention
and Drift locks, and the exclusions of the Worker and Reviewer frames (§9,
§10) among them.
Selecting the configuration makes none of them optional, and no operation
grant lifts them (P6).

The
Executive acquires what a decision needs beyond that view through its
frame inputs (§8) or by activating a further bounded evaluation (§6). A
compact result carries every blocker material to delivery, as that rule
requires, in the residuals, stop basis and effect values of a work
result, the findings, counterexamples and residuals of a review result,
and the residuals of a specialist result (P0, P4b, P6).

constraints.statement: All selected-profile grants, duties, limits and prohibitions apply without exception or waiver by operation grants. Allocation explanation covers fit, finite actor contexts and failure assumptions: Worker holds one causal cone, Reviewer one exact claim/evidence, Executive outcome/frontier/closed ledger rather than evaluator context. Product basis records concrete capability envelopes; selected execution binding supplies time/spend/resource values, declared, measured and honoured under ACTIVATION §6. Constructor fallibility requires independence where assessment is required; coordinator self-effects motivate its mutation ban; staleness requires drift checks; failed activation returns cause without Worker result; uncertain effects require reconciliation before reactivation/dependent action. Every intended effect receives its imported Effects value. Every delivery-material blocker must survive compact reporting in work residuals/stop basis/effect values, review findings/counterexamples/residuals or specialist residuals. Executive acquires additional decision needs through frame inputs or further bounded evaluation. The new subsection is an allocation explanation, not a default-configuration claim.
constraints.uncertainty: Concrete execution-binding resource values are not supplied.

conditions: The Executive frame is activated.

grounding.quote:
| capability envelope | enough method, Product, release or MVP, authority, workspace, triage and actor-selection competence to configure, prioritise and dispose the bounded evaluation; implementation expertise may be delegated to specialist frames |
| exclusions | candidate, Product or worktree byte mutation and implementation effects while occupying the frame; implementation ownership; silently rewriting Reviewer evidence or severity; claiming independent review without a qualifying activation; semantic reconstruction owned elsewhere; disposition outside the admitted grant |
| result | one core result (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results), the assigned priority and current-boundary effect, and one existing disposition (ACTIVATION §3 Disposition) where the basis is decidable |
| invalidation | a material change of method, authority, outcome, mandate, triage policy, checkpoint, candidate, evidence, finding, capability or topology |

constraints.statement: Evaluate authorisation of bounded outcome/basis, capable frames/actors, exact current results and mandate-derived priority/effect/disposition/action. Basis includes complete selected method cut, exact Goals/Product/requirements/design/work authority, current mandate/workspace/checkpoint, findings/triage, selected policy and any proxy grant. Manifold includes causal cone, inventory, configuration, envelopes, obligations, returns, re-entry owners and already-authorised continuation; coordinates bind exact method/project/outcome/mandate/authority/checkpoint/candidate/evidence/finding/policy/actor identities. Governing references are RF-001–RF-017, execution/intake and design conservation laws, and applicable identity/carrier/assurance/release law. Evidence is live authority, exact candidate/transition, frame and specialist results, triage and coverage residuals. Capability covers method, Product, mandate, authority, workspace, triage and actor selection; implementation expertise may be delegated. Exclude mutation, implementation ownership, silent evidence/severity rewriting, unqualified independent-review claims, others' semantic reconstruction and out-of-grant disposition. Return one core result plus priority/effect and one existing disposition where decidable. Material changes to method, authority, outcome, mandate, policy, checkpoint, candidate, evidence, finding, capability or topology invalidate. No authorize/no_action disposition is added: activation is activate; dispositions are exactly accept/local_repair/re_enter/reject. Unsupported technical assessment requires capable reevaluation or retained uncertainty.
constraints.uncertainty: Referenced governing invariant texts are not supplied.

conditions: Delivery uses this profile's steel-thread strategy.
exceptions: Other strategies remain lawful for other configurations.

grounding.quote:
During construction, focused deterministic regression and targeted
judgment probes resolve material uncertainty, and unit evidence covers
module-owned laws under the testing frames (ASSURANCE §7). Substantial,
resource-intensive user-acceptance cycles are scheduled near release or
when a bounded capability is complete enough to qualify; an early focused
user probe stays appropriate where it decides a material outcome
uncertainty (P2, ACTIVATION §7 proof cadence).

The product testing frames keep their distinct claims and govern the
necessary scenarios, independent assessments and repetitions. Qualified
results are reused while their exact subject and basis stay valid; affected
assurance is rerun when a material change invalidates it. The Executive
selects this sequence under the existing mandate and activates construction
only through the existing operation grants (P6, P4b).

constraints.statement: Choose increments by consequential uncertainty, dependency/interface reach and failure impact. Early end-to-end/integration evidence prunes incompatible choices, settles exercised interfaces and preserves working composition while concentrating on unresolved obligations. Passing threads prove only exercised relations/conditions; untested branches, combinations, refusal and recovery retain material obligations. Reopen decisions when material counterevidence invalidates their basis. Construction uses focused deterministic regression, targeted judgment probes and unit evidence for module-owned laws. Schedule substantial user acceptance near release or sufficiently complete bounded capability; focused early probes remain appropriate for material outcome uncertainty. Testing frames retain distinct claims and determine necessary scenarios, independent assessments and repetitions. Reuse qualified exact-subject/basis-valid results; rerun affected assurance after material invalidation. Sequence under existing mandate and activate construction only through existing operation grants.

conditions: A Worker is lawfully activated.

grounding.quote:
| authority | inherited bounded construction or transformation authority and self-review only; mutation only where the exact inherited owner grant names the subject and write territory; no admission, publication, independent acceptance, frame-set revision or inferred next action |
| evidence | live implementation, tests and test source, analysis, generated artifacts, installed or operational behaviour where claimed, reconstruction, mutations and exact transition evidence |
| capability envelope | the declared method, domain, implementation, tool, access and finite-context competence the causal cone requires |
| exclusions | upstream semantic change, unauthorised cone expansion, self-acceptance, hidden competing paths, and advancing after returning the work result |
| result | exactly one work-result value, which carries the one core value ACTIVATION §3 maps it to for "a candidate is available" (§5 Work result); each evaluation the Worker performed keeps its own core result (FOUNDATIONS §4 Results) |
| invalidation | a material change of intake, basis, checkpoint, dependency, configuration, capability or topology |

constraints.statement: Construct the exact authorised outcome through the smallest coherent causal cone, preserving every affected governing relation and disposing competing paths. Use sufficient intake and applicable accepted design-to-execution basis. Cover material entities, lifecycles, transformations, authorities, capabilities, algorithms, inputs/outputs, dependencies, seams, failures and proof obligations with exact activation/checkpoint/workspace/input/dependency/configuration/envelope/output/candidate/evidence identities and all material selected method/project laws. Evidence includes live implementation, tests/source, analysis, generated artifacts, claimed installed/operational behaviour, reconstruction, mutations and transitions; capability includes declared method/domain/implementation/tools/access/finite context. Authority is inherited construction/transformation and self-review only; no admission, publication, independent acceptance, frame-set revision, inferred action, upstream semantic change, unauthorised expansion, self-acceptance, hidden competing paths or continuation after return. Emit exactly one work-result value while each performed evaluation retains its own core result. Material intake/basis/checkpoint/dependency/configuration/capability/topology changes invalidate. Green tests evidence only exercised production/test semantics. Missing, ambiguous or out-of-territory mutation authority refuses effects. Read scope covers the full causal cone within access grants, possibly beyond write territory; inspect material producers/consumers/owners and return outside-territory repairs to their owners.

conditions: Reviewer assessment is activated; independent review is required only at applicable imported or governing-basis boundaries.

grounding.quote:
| authority | bounded evaluation only; review access yields no construction, transformation, admission, publication, mutation, decision, disposition or next-activation authority |
| evidence | independently acquired live authority, candidate implementation, tests, artifacts, history, operational evidence, mutations, replay or reconstruction, and reproduced observations material to the claim and the technical triage |
| capability envelope | declared method, domain, implementation, assurance, technical-triage, tool, access, context, counterexample-search and independence competence |
| exclusions | editing the candidate, implementing a repair, assigning priority, disposing the release or MVP boundary, selecting the next action, substituting the Worker's summary, assurance-owned semantic reconstruction, flattening unbound evidence, silent scope expansion |
| result | one core result with findings, counterexamples, evidence-bound technical triage and residuals sufficient for the Executive to assign priority and apply the existing disposition where the basis is decidable |
| invalidation | a material change of candidate, authority, basis, evidence population, severity scale, dependency, configuration, scope or independence |

Each finding binds a violated property, a supported entry or state, the
governing operating or threat model and a credible causal path. The same
conditions apply to retained guards and acceptance predicates as to new
findings. An excluded threat alone gives no retention claim; a proposed
wider threat model re-enters its owner. Internal location alone does not
establish trust, and hypothetical hostility alone does not establish
applicability. The actual untrusted-input, mutable-state, authority and
effect checks the supported model requires are retained. A suggested repair
becomes an obligation only through its proper owner (P6, P2, P5).

constraints.statement: Evaluate exact subject/basis against applicable method/project relations without competing authority, proof masking or unevaluated composition, and derive supported severity/implications. Basis binds candidate, claim, authority, scope/exclusions, evidence population, severity scale, carrier and independence. Cover causal producers/consumers, authority seams, competing paths, claimed failure/recovery/installed/reconstruction surfaces, test/fixture semantics, history and supported triage. Coordinates bind candidate/source basis/authority revision/configuration/dependencies/population/scale/installed subject/review time/Reviewer. Apply RF-001–RF-017, execution, independence/traceability, assurance/freeze and applicable Product/design/identity/release law. Independently acquire live material evidence with declared method/domain/implementation/assurance/triage/tool/access/context/counterexample-search/independence capability. Review access grants evaluation only, never construction, transformation, admission, publication, mutation, decision, disposition or next activation. Exclude repair, priority, next-action selection, Worker-summary substitution, others' assurance reconstruction, unbound evidence flattening and silent scope expansion. Return one core result with findings, counterexamples, supported triage and residuals; material candidate/authority/basis/population/scale/dependency/configuration/scope/independence changes invalidate. No universal review round, new independence test or second verdict/disposition family is added. Unsupported triage remains uncertainty; repair-risk assessment does not confer repair ownership. Review test code/fixtures/mutations/environment/interpretation whenever they can change proof; passing status is no substitute. Every finding, retained guard and acceptance predicate binds violated property, supported entry/state, operating/threat model and credible causal path. Excluded threats alone justify no retention; wider models re-enter their owner. Internal location proves no trust; hypothetical hostility proves no applicability. Retain supported-model checks and create repair obligations only through the proper owner.
constraints.uncertainty: Independent-review applicability, traceability and independence tests remain imported.

conditions: A generic frame is recursively refined or a composite claim is evaluated.

grounding.quote:
When a generic frame is recursively refined, each child declaration records
its parent contract, purpose, material entities, identity and lifecycle
relations, semantic owners, direct sibling seams, applicable invariants and
prohibited competing paths. Refinement opens only for a material
distinction needed to close the parent evaluation. It is a frame dependency
relation, not an organisational or runtime hierarchy (P2, P4a; ACTIVATION
§4).

A composite with any of these cases is never `satisfied`; it reports the
non-satisfied value that FOUNDATIONS §4, Reported value, gives, with each
gap recorded by kind. Which non-satisfied value it reports where several
are returned is the conjunction rule the adopting project declares (§19
Project-basis additions). This profile's own declared choice is that no
frame is selected as dominant.

constraints.statement: Refine only for a material distinction needed to close the parent; every child records parent contract, purpose, material entities, identity/lifecycle, semantic owners, direct sibling seams, invariants and prohibited paths. This is evaluation dependency, not organisational/runtime hierarchy. For each mandatory material seam: unperformed assessment or only stale/wrong-subject/basis result is a planned-assessment gap with no value; unplanned material seam is uncovered-coverage gap with no value; evaluated failed conservation/translation is falsified or the owner-defined refused-translation outcome/core by cause; undecidable evidence gives indeterminate; undeclared needed translation/relation gives out_of_frame; evaluation performed on stale/advanced/ambiguous/mismatched basis has its own returned invalid_basis. Any such case prevents satisfied. Record gaps by kind; imported conjunction law and the adopting project's declared rule choose among multiple non-satisfied values. No frame is dominant. Consumer-specific frames, runtime roles, topology and renamed substitutes are not imported; material local frames may be declared only under their Product/accepted-design authority.
constraints.uncertainty: Full conjunction aggregation and refused-translation cause mapping are not supplied.

conditions: One sufficient frame permits direct engagement.

grounding.quote:
The steps below describe the coordinated branch selected under §3. Direct
Worker engagement keeps the same sufficient intake, work-result algebra,
closure conditions and owner boundaries without inserting an Executive
appointment, or a review that no applicable condition requires (P0, P6;
rc.2 #complete-engagement-transition).
using this profile adds no review, ticket, diagram recreation or owner ceremony to such a task.

constraints.statement: Coordinated transition steps apply to the selected coordinated branch. Direct Worker/Writer entry retains sufficient admission/intake, carrier, territory, obligations, evidence, stop conditions, result consumer, work-result algebra, closure and owner boundaries. It adds no Executive appointment, unrequired review, ticket, diagram recreation or owner ceremony. The direct step still records its result and satisfies the same outer contract.

conditions: An outcome and work authority are selected.

grounding.quote:
Goals, Product, requirements, accepted design, a ticket, release law or an
admitted bounded proxy selects the outcome and the work authority under its
existing owner. The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis
(PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7) projects that decision (P6; rc.2
#1-existing-authority-selects-the-basis).

constraints.statement: Goals, Product, requirements, accepted design, ticket, release law or an admitted bounded proxy selects outcome and work authority under its existing owner; the Product-owned basis projects that decision rather than creating its authority.

conditions: The coordinated branch activates a Worker.
constraints.statement: Executive applies activate to sufficient ACTIVATION §1 intake using the REFERENCE_FRAME §11 packet. Identify complete selected method/project authority, exact outcome/checkpoint, affected causal relations/invariants, computational relations/specialists, Worker authority/capability, evidence/qualification duties, exclusions/prohibited paths, stop/re-entry conditions and exact already-authorised action. When testing is required include claims, subjects, topology, combination populations, ordinary paths, oracles and forbidden paths; when mutation is authorised include inherited exact grant, subject and write territory. Known capability, authority, subject, basis or topology mismatch returns activation_refusal directly to Executive with imported cause/core value. No Worker is active, evaluation occurs or synthetic Worker result is created.

conditions: Worker activation has lawfully occurred.
exceptions: Direct work returns to its declared consumer rather than necessarily to an Executive.

grounding.quote:
The notation explains and mandates no schema. The material relation of
`re_entry_requested` names its cause, authority or basis, which is part of
the value. Each value maps to exactly one core value for "a candidate is
available" under
[ACTIVATION §3 Construction availability](ACTIVATION.md#construction-availability),
read as in §5 Work result; the mapping applies only after lawful
activation. The Worker does not send a candidate directly into an
implicitly active Reviewer. It stops after returning the result (P5,
P6).

constraints.statement: Every coordinated activation ends in one closed work result to Executive. The explanatory WorkerResult notation carries candidate_ready(exact_subject, transition_evidence, residuals), refused(reason, authority, evidence), incomplete(residuals, evidence, stop_basis), or re_entry_requested(owner, material_relation, evidence); the latter's authority-versus-basis cause is part of its value and preserves the five-value distinction. The notation mandates no schema. Worker stops after return and never sends a candidate to an implicitly active Reviewer.

conditions: Executive consumes a closed work result.

grounding.quote:
Whatever the variant, an effect of uncertain completion, one the work
result names `completion_unknown` or names `not_effected` with its end not
established ([ACTIVATION §3 Effects](ACTIVATION.md#effects)), is
reconciled under
[ACTIVATION §5](ACTIVATION.md#5-work-state-and-restart), sufficiently for
the next dependent action, before work is reactivated, the effect is
repeated or any action that depends on it is taken (P5, P6).
